name: aerocraft-bear-forgestack
description: AeroCraft class completions from the real utility catalog, hovers with color swatches, and Bear JSX hints. Optional Tailwind-style alias mode.

aerocraft.enableCompletions.description: Suggest AeroCraft classes in class/className/@apply, Bear JSX props on supported tags, and enable related hovers.

aerocraft.utilityAliasMode.description: Also suggest parallel utility-style names (e.g. flex flex-col) next to AeroCraft shortcuts for teams mixing stacks.

bear.enableComponentSnippets.description: Register Bear import and JSX snippets in TypeScript React.
